note: Development sets only (post hoc, §9.33 M1). diff = B - A in percentage points of lineage Top-k. ci = patient-paired bootstrap 95% (2,000, seed 0); ci_cluster = gold-disease cluster bootstrap 95%; disease_equal = mean over gold clusters of the per-cluster difference, clusters resampled; p = exact McNemar, p_holm = Holm across the stratum's sets for one comparison at one k. Macro = equal-weight mean over the stratum's sets: ci_patient = paired_stats.macro_compare (set-stratified patient bootstrap), ci_cluster / disease_equal = macro_cluster (clusters resampled within each set). RRF w chosen on the same nine sets (selection optimism).

rrf_selection.criterion: D3: dev macro lineage Top-10 over the nine development sets, ties Top-1, smaller w first
rrf_selection.lineage_check: S-mix and HPOA/HPOA-LOPO list files give the same lineage for every gold set
rrf_selection.endpoint_check: w = 0 and w = 1 reproduce the stored S-mix and HPOA ranks for every patient

decision.rule: §9.33 M1: 'complementary' only if, in the unpublished hospital stratum (PUMCH_L, PUMCH-ADM), combination - HPOA and combination - S-mix both have a macro Top-10 CI lower bound > 0 (required of the patient-stratified, the gold-disease cluster and the disease-equal CI)
decision.verdict: not complementary: neither combination meets the §9.33 M1 rule

rrf_lopo_trail.note: nine-set dev macro of RRF with HPOA-LOPO at each w (not used to select)
